title: Gold Plus Saver Account: Mobile banking and deposit limits
summary: This document explains mobile check deposit and outbound transfer limits for the Gold Plus Saver Account: daily mobile deposit limit is $15,000 (amounts above aren’t accepted the same day), and the maximum daily outbound transfer amount is $50,000. It also provides deposit best practices (endorse clearly, use well-lit images, retain checks until they clear) and guidance to manage daily caps (batch/split transfers, review totals, use approval workflows).
